newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE - Russian 182-day T-bill yields 17.16 pct.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Russian 182-day T-bill yields 17.16 pct.

text.p: The annualised average yield on an issue of Russian 182-day GKO discount Treasury bills was 17.16 percent at auction on Wednesday, the central bank said.
Dealers had forecast the average yield would be in the 16.51-17.80 percent range.
The series 22077 bills, maturing on June 24, 1998, the closest maturity date to the new issue, on Tuesday closed at 85.54, to yield 18.74 percent.
Earlier, the Finance Ministry raised 3.95 trillion roubles in a sale of 364-day T-bills (series 21081), bringing total proceeds from Wednesday's auctions to 7.09 trillion roubles.
It has also repaid about 6.72 trillion roubles in a maturing issue of 259-day T-bills (series 22058).
